skill.summary: Boost developer productivity with Gitai: An AI-powered Git automation tool that analyzes code changes and generates semantic Conventional Commits instantly. Supports Node.js, Python, Java, Go, PHP, and more. Compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Groq.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Removed installation and update scripts (`scripts/install.sh`, `scripts/update.sh`) from the project.
- Updated documentation to require manual installation and configuration of the `@notyped/gitai` CLI tool before use.
- Clarified that the agent must not attempt installation or configuration of dependencies.
- Updated setup instructions to enforce prerequisite checks for both the CLI tool and its configuration file. 
- Removed all references to automated install/update commands from the usage guide.
